import requests

def get_entry_details(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}.json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    mass = res.get('sequence', {}).get('molWeight')
    length = res.get('sequence', {}).get('length')
    protein_name = res.get('proteinDescription', {}).get('recommendedName', {}).get('fullName', {}).get('value')
    
    # check alternative isoforms
    isoforms = []
    for comment in res.get('comments', []):
        if comment.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            for iso in comment.get('isoforms', []):
                isoforms.append((iso.get('name', {}).get('value'), iso.get('isoformIds')))
                
    return {
        'accession': accession,
        'protein_name': protein_name,
        'length': length,
        'mass_Da': mass,
        'mass_kDa': mass / 1000.0,
        'isoforms': isoforms
    }

print("VTI1A:", get_entry_details("Q96AJ9"))
print("CDC42EP2:", get_entry_details("O14613"))

        continue
    lines = entry.strip().split('\n')
